evidence: Running the reported example locally produced d1_p1=[0.09500000000000001] and d2_p1=[0.09000000000000001] after translating both samples by delta=0.02, so p=1 is not invariant under joint rotation. The same repro gave p2_allclose=True with d1_p2=[0.017550000000000007] and d2_p2=[0.017550000000000003].
steps: Added a minimal repro script that imports the local codebase and evaluates ot.wasserstein_circle on the issue report inputs.
Ran bash run_repro.sh to capture stdout and stderr in repro_stdout.log and repro_stderr.log.
Verified the p=1 outputs differ while the p=2 outputs match up to floating-point noise.
